# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer and housekeeper  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves, possessing dark hair with graying strands tied tightly at the back in a firm bun. Over time, her hair becomes more silvered, though her sharp contours remain. Around her mouth lies an expression that hints at a hidden capacity for humor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Thirza is a practical, firm, and uncompromisingly moral woman who insists on agonising cleanliness and orderly living. She is deeply reserved with her affection, often masking her tender feelings behind a strict, sharp, or fault-finding exterior out of fear of being overly lenient. Despite her stern nature, she possesses a hidden sense of humor, a strong conscience, and a capacity for deep, enduring devotion to her home and charges.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c15 P97](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0097), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)_

## Traits

- Strictly moral and uncompromising  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- Meticulous and clean  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Reserved in expressing love  <sub>[v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>
- Opposed to tobacco use  <sub>[v1 c3 P51](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0051)</sub>
- Reluctant to express opinions on ministers  <sub>[v1 c21 P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Dairy and household management  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>
- Sewing and dressmaking  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Nell Harcourt with proper morality and conduct  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007)</sub>
- To preserve and maintain Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c38 P13](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0013), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother Obed. Wishing to take in an orphan boy to assist around the farm, they send a message to Mrs. Tranter, but due to a mix-up, an eleven-year-old girl named Nell Harcourt is brought instead. Although initially intending to return her, Thirza and Obed agree to take Nell on trial, and Thirza undertakes her moral upbringing, religious education, and schooling. Over time, Thirza grows deeply attached to Nell, eventually coming to regard her as the most precious thing in her life. When Obed passes away years later, a grieving Thirza contemplates selling Grey Shutters due to eye trouble and loneliness, but she is dissuaded when Nell decides to decline her college scholarship to stay home and teach. Following the death of a distant acquaintance, Thirza takes in the orphaned twins David (Robin) and Lucy Farrow. Later, after Thomas Sowerby passes away, Thirza invites her longtime friend, the widowed Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, to come live with her at Grey Shutters under a mutual agreement.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v1 c38 P28](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0028), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Grey Shutters built by her shy, bashful father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Overheard an aunt call her a dark, homely child during her youth  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited an exquisite oval amethyst brooch containing her mother's hair  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
